routes.name: Sushi
routes.desc: Everybody likes Sushi! Shares anchors with 'Wasabi'. 1 bolt, 4 slings.

routes.name: Wasabi
routes.desc: Shares anchors with 'Sushi'.

routes.name: Sexual Climber
routes.desc: 5m extension to either 'Sushi' or 'Wasabi'. After the last bolt of 'Wasabi', head up right to the anchors of 'Air Jordan'.

routes.name: Dazed and Confused
routes.desc: Start on top of pedestal. After vertical crack traverse right stepping across gap and continue right and up the tufa systems.

routes.name: Red Lining / Red Lining.to the Max
routes.desc: Same start as 'Dazed and Confused', then head left into the openbook corner. Continue left up the face with the thin tufa to the anchor.

routes.name: Dazed Lining
routes.desc: Same start as 'Red Lining', then head left into the openbook corner and continue right up the face with the big tufa to the anchor of 'Dazed and Confused'. Grade needs to be settled. Please mark your grade (6c or 6c+) when logging ascents.

routes.name: Air Jordan
routes.desc: Same start as 'Red Lining'/'Dazed and Confused', then left via crazy Superman-dyno to the big hole. Shares anchors with 'Sexual Climber'. 8 bolts, 2 slings. Grade needs confirmation, please try!

routes.name: Motor City Madhouse
routes.desc: Up the ladder. Gives access to the following routes, all starting from the Rock'n Roll ledge.

routes.name: Vagabonds of the Western World
routes.desc: Left route starting from the left belay anchor on the Rock'n Roll ledge. Access via 'Motor City Madhouse'.

routes.name: Tangled up in Blue
routes.desc: Warning Flora and Fauna: Hornets Right route starting from the left belay anchor on the Rock'n Roll ledge. Access via 'Motor City Madhouse'.

routes.name: Shotgun Blues
routes.desc: Leftmost route on the right side of the Rock'n Roll ledge. Access via 'Motor City Madhouse' and traversing right along the fixed rope.

routes.name: Creep
routes.desc: Middle line starting from the right belay anchor on the Rock'n Roll ledge. Access via 'Motor City Madhouse' and traversing right along the fixed rope.

routes.name: Master of Puppets
routes.desc: Right line starting from the right belay anchor on the Rock'n Roll ledge. Access via 'Motor City Madhouse' and traversing right along the fixed rope. Climb up and right of the huge stalactite above the belay.

routes.name: Lady Rose
routes.desc: Warning Fixed Gear: Two slings need replacing First climb to left of 'Can I Play with Madness'. Climb past 3 bolts, step over the ledge, clipping slings, and traverse around/out onto the bulging face and arête to finish.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Two slings need replacing

routes.name: Can I Play with Madness
routes.desc: The straight line to the right anchor on the Rock'n Roll ledge, up the white face. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Mad Max
routes.desc: Shares the first jug-hold on 'Can I Play with Madness', then immediately head right and up the face towards the tufa. (No sidewall bridging to right).

routes.name: Furiosa
routes.desc: Four-bolt extension to 'Mad Max'. Open project. Please try!

routes.name: Keep Yourself Alive
routes.desc: Must-do climb! Climbs the obvious corner right of 'Mad Max'. Jugs and bridging, slightly polished footholds. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Simon's Tales
routes.desc: Start up the overhang and exit the lip with some bridging and straight up the arête. Shares anchors with 'Keep Yourself Alive'.

routes.name: Thunderstruck
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Heartbreaker', then left towards the cave after the 4th clip and up on the inside of the pillar. Rejoins with 'Heartbreaker' after the 10th clip. 9 bolts, 8 slings.

routes.name: Heartbreaker
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Thunderstruck'. Veers right after the 4th clip into the white tufa pipes. Rejoins with 'Thunderstruck' about halfway. 5 bolts, 12 slings.

routes.name: Spanish Caravan
routes.desc: Straight up the steep orange-white rock into the white tufa pipes. Joins up with 'The Passenger' about halfway. 6 bolts, 9 slings.

routes.name: The Passenger
routes.desc: Climbs up on orange tufas, 3m right of 'Spanish Caravan'. Then slightly left to join 'Spanish Caravan' on the ledge about halfway. 8 bolts, 10 slings.

routes.name: Psycho Killer
routes.desc: Easy sustained climbing all the way to the roof, a perfect warm up. It's the second to last route at the sector (starts left of 'The End'). At the anchor it's possible to continue into 'Freebird'. 9 bolts, 4 slings

routes.name: Freebird
routes.desc: Same start as 'The End' for 6 bolts, then go left.

routes.name: The End
routes.desc: About 5m right of 'The Passenger', on structured brown and white rock. Fun moves on crimps towards the anchor. Titanium bolts and slings.

routes.name: Krabi Bolt Fund
routes.desc: To the right of 'The End'. Has its own anchor.

routes.name: Rock & Sun
routes.desc: To the right of Krabi Bolt Fund. Has its own anchor.
